brief: The mayor, and the player. Row order down, up, left, right. Frame order idle, step left, idle, step right. A sash or a chain of office, otherwise plain. Feet land on the anchor in every frame or the character bobs.
sketchNote: One cell, facing down, idle. The sheet is 4 rows (down, up, left, right) x 4 frames (idle, step left, idle, step right). The = is the sash of office. Feet sit on the last row in every frame.
